selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 serves time and node2 synchronizes exclusively from node1
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 is synchronized, listening on UDP/123, and records node2 as a client. Node2 shows 10.100.76.10 as its sole selected source with normal leap status and microsecond-scale offset.
Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic before and after configuration and restarts.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from a95da956-aa3e-4fec-a746-fbb828074410 to d3e3b334-030e-4924-a4ac-f642cd8e1487; chrony, configuration, listener, upstream synchronization, and node2 client traffic recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 to 76aa7bf0-82ab-4ad0-9fa0-067dd5316502; chrony auto-started and resumed synchronization exclusively with node1.
